units.text: 8. The commission has a quorum to perform its functions if at least fifty per cent of its total membership participates in the meeting. Commission members may participate using videoconferencing systems, subject to compliance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the protection of State secrets. The chair must notify commission members in good time of the place (where necessary), date and time of the meeting. Commission members may not delegate their powers to other persons.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 39

units.text: 9. A commission decision made in violation of this Federal Law may be challenged by any procurement participant in the procedure established by this Federal Law and may be declared invalid by decision of the procurement oversight body.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 39

units.text: 10. In conducting procurement, commission members must take measures to prevent and resolve conflicts of interest in accordance with Federal Law No. 273-FZ of 25 December 2008 “On Combating Corruption”, including in the light of information provided to the contracting authority under Article 34(23) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 39

units.text: Article 40. Specialized organization
units.label: Art. 40

units.text: 1. The contracting authority may engage a specialized organization under a contract to perform individual functions in selecting a supplier (contractor, service provider), including developing procurement documentation (where this Federal Law provides for procurement documentation), posting the information and electronic documents provided for by this Federal Law in the unified information system and on the electronic platform, sending invitations and performing other functions connected with arranging supplier (contractor, service provider) selection. However, establishing the procurement commission, determining the initial (maximum) contract price, the initial unit price of goods, works or services, the initial total of those unit prices, the subject matter and other essential terms of the contract, approving the draft contract and procurement documentation (where this Federal Law provides for procurement documentation), and signing the contract are the responsibility of the contracting authority.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 40

units.text: 2. The contracting authority shall select the specialized organization in accordance with this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 40

units.text: 3. The specialized organization performs the functions specified in paragraph 1 of this Article on behalf of the contracting authority. The rights and obligations resulting from the performance of those functions arise for the contracting authority.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 40

units.text: 4. The contracting authority is jointly and severally liable for harm caused to an individual or legal entity by unlawful acts (omissions) of the specialized organization committed within the powers transferred to it by the contracting authority under a contract and relating to supplier (contractor, service provider) selection, when it performs the functions specified in paragraph 1 of this Article on behalf of the contracting authority.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 40

units.text: 5. A specialized organization may not be a participant in a procurement in which it performs the functions specified in paragraph 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 40

units.text: Article 41. Experts and expert organizations
units.label: Art. 41

units.text: 1. Contracting authorities engage experts and expert organizations in the case provided for in Article 94(3) of this Federal Law. Contracting authorities may engage experts and expert organizations to conduct an expert appraisal of a procurement notice, procurement documentation (where this Federal Law provides for procurement documentation), or applications to participate in procurement.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 41

units.text: 2. The following may not be admitted to conduct an expert examination in the cases provided for by this Federal Law:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 41

units.text: 1) individuals:
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 41

units.text: а) who are, or were at any time less than two years before the date of the expert examination, officials or employees of the contracting authority arranging the examination or of the supplier (contractor, service provider);
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 2 Art. 41

units.text: б) who have a proprietary interest in the conclusion of the contract that is the subject of the expert examination;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 2 Art. 41

units.text: в) who are close relatives (relatives in the direct ascending and descending lines (parents and children, grandparents and grandchildren), full or half siblings (sharing a father or mother)), adoptive parents or adopted children of the head of the contracting authority, members of the procurement commission, the head of the contract service, the contract manager, or officials or employees of the supplier (contractor, service provider), or who are married to such persons;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 1 Part 2 Art. 41

units.text: 2) legal entities in which the contracting authority or the supplier (contractor, service provider) has the right to control more than twenty per cent of the total votes attached to voting shares, or more than twenty per cent of the contributions or participatory interests constituting their charter or pooled capital;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 41

units.text: 3) individuals or legal entities where the contracting authority or the supplier (contractor, service provider) can directly and/or indirectly (through a third party) influence the outcome of the expert examination conducted by that person or those persons.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 41

units.text: 3. An expert or expert organization must notify the contracting authority and the supplier (contractor, service provider) in writing that its participation in the expert examination is permissible (including that there are no grounds for exclusion under paragraph 2 of this Article).
units.label: Part 3 Art. 41

units.text: 4. If persons specified in paragraph 2 of this Article are identified among the experts or expert organizations, the contracting authority must immediately take measures to engage another expert or expert organization to conduct the examination.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 41

units.text: 5. Additional requirements for experts and expert organizations engaged to examine goods delivered, works performed or services provided under a State defence order, and specific rules for such examinations, may be established by Federal Law No. 275-FZ of 29 December 2012 “On the State Defence Order”.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 41

units.text: 6. To conduct an expert examination in the cases provided for by this Federal Law, experts and expert organizations may request additional materials relating to its subject matter from the contracting authority or the supplier (contractor, service provider).
units.label: Part 6 Art. 41

units.text: 7. The results of an examination conducted by an expert or expert organization in the cases provided for by this Federal Law shall be set out in an opinion signed by the expert or an authorized representative of the expert organization; the opinion must be objective, substantiated and consistent with the legislation of the Russian Federation. For providing inaccurate examination results or an inaccurate expert opinion, or a knowingly false expert opinion, and for failure by an expert or expert organization to comply with paragraph 3 of this Article, the expert, expert organization, its authorized representative and its officials are liable in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 41

units.text: 8. Where an expert examination requires research, testing, works or services, and the legislation of the Russian Federation imposes mandatory requirements on those performing them (mandatory accreditation, licensing or membership of self-regulatory organizations), experts and expert organizations for that examination must be selected from persons meeting those requirements.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 41

units.text: Article 42. Procurement notice
units.label: Art. 42

units.text: 1. When procuring through open competitive methods, the contracting authority shall use the unified information system to prepare a procurement notice, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorized to act on its behalf, and post it in the unified information system. The notice must contain the following information:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 1) the name, location, postal address, email address, contact telephone number and responsible official of the contracting authority and of the specialized organization (where engaged by the contracting authority);
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 2) the procurement identification code determined under Article 23 of this Federal Law, an indication of the relevant paragraph of Article 15 of this Federal Law under which the procurement is conducted (where procurement is conducted under Article 15(4)–(6) of this Federal Law), and an indication that procurement is conducted under Federal Law No. 275-FZ of 29 December 2012 “On the State Defence Order”, which indication shall not be posted on the official website;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 3) the method of selecting the supplier (contractor, service provider);
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 4) the Internet address of the electronic platform (for an electronic procedure) or specialized electronic platform (for a closed electronic procedure);
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 5) the name of the procurement subject matter, information (where available) required by the rules for using the catalogue of goods, works and services for State and municipal needs established under Article 23(6) of this Federal Law, and, for procurement of medicines, their international non-proprietary names or, in the absence of such names, their chemical or group names;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 6) information on quantity (except in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law), unit of measurement and place of delivery of goods (when procuring goods, including goods delivered to the contracting authority in the course of performing the procured works or providing the procured services);
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 7) information on the volume (except in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law), unit of measurement (where applicable) and place of performance of works or provision of services;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 8) the deadline for performance of the contract (individual stages of performance, if the draft contract provides for such stages). In the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law, the notice shall state that the deadlines for individual stages of performance are determined on the basis of orders from the contracting authority in the manner specified in the contract;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 9) the initial (maximum) contract price (the price of individual stages of performance, if the draft contract provides for such stages), the source of funding, and the currency name according to the All-Russian Classification of Currencies. In the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law, the initial unit price of goods, works or services, the initial total of those unit prices and the maximum contract price shall be stated, without stating the prices of individual stages of performance. In the cases determined by the Government of the Russian Federation under Article 34(2) of this Federal Law, the estimated contract price or the price formula and maximum contract price shall be stated;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 10) the amount of the advance payment (if an advance payment is provided for);
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 11) the criteria for evaluating tender applications and the weights of those criteria in accordance with this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 12) the requirements for procurement participants under Article 31(1) of this Federal Law, the requirements under Article 31(2) and (2.1) of this Federal Law (where applicable), information and an exhaustive list of documents demonstrating that a procurement participant meets those requirements, and the requirement under Article 31(1.1) of this Federal Law (where applicable);
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 13) information on the granting of preferences under Articles 28 and 29 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 14) information on preferences in participation in supplier (contractor, service provider) selection under Article 30(3) of this Federal Law, or the requirement established under Article 30(5) of this Federal Law, indicating, in accordance with Article 30(6) of this Federal Law, the volume of contract performance to be assigned to subcontractors and co-providers that are small enterprises or socially oriented non-profit organizations;
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 15) information on a prohibition or restriction on procurement of goods originating in foreign States (including goods supplied in the course of performing the procured works or providing the procured services), works performed or services provided by foreign persons, and on a preference for goods of Russian origin (including goods supplied in the course of performing the procured works or providing the procured services), works performed or services provided by Russian persons, where such a prohibition, restriction or preference has been established under Article 14(2)(1) of this Federal Law in respect of goods (including goods supplied in the course of performing the procured work or providing the procured service), works or services that are the subject matter of the procurement;
units.label: Point 15 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 16) the amount and procedure for depositing funds as security for an application to participate in procurement, the terms of the independent guarantee (if application security is required under Article 44 of this Federal Law), details of the account in which transactions involving funds received by the contracting authority are recorded under the legislation of the Russian Federation, and details of the account for transferring funds in the case provided for in Article 44(13) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 16 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 17) the amount of security for contract performance and warranty obligations, the procedure for providing it and the requirements for it (if security for contract performance or warranty obligations is required under Article 96 of this Federal Law);
units.label: Point 17 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 18) information on banking support for the contract under Article 35 of this Federal Law and on treasury support (if, under the legislation of the Russian Federation, payments under the contract or advance payments under it are subject to treasury support);
units.label: Point 18 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 19) information on the contracting authority’s ability to conclude the contracts specified in Article 34(10) of this Federal Law with several procurement participants, indicating the number of those contracts;
units.label: Point 19 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 20) information on the possibility of unilateral refusal to perform the contract under Article 95 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 20 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 21) the date and time of the deadline for submitting applications to participate in procurement. That date may not fall on a non-working day;
units.label: Point 21 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 22) the deadline for examining and evaluating the first parts of applications to participate in procurement (for an electronic tender, except in the case provided for in Article 48(19) of this Federal Law), the deadline for examining and evaluating the second parts of applications (for an electronic tender), the deadline for examining applications (for a closed auction), and the date for determining the results of supplier (contractor, service provider) selection in accordance with this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 22 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 23) for an electronic tender (except in the case provided for in Article 48(19) of this Federal Law) or auctions, the date of the procedure for submitting offers of the contract price or the total of unit prices of goods, works or services (in the case provided for in Article 22(24) of this Federal Law). For an electronic tender, the date specified in this point must be the working day following the deadline for examining and evaluating the first parts of procurement applications. For an electronic auction, the procedure specified in this point begins two hours after the deadline for submitting procurement applications;
units.label: Point 23 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 24) a warning of administrative and criminal liability for violation of the requirements of the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation prohibiting participation in agreements restricting competition and the carrying out of concerted actions restricting competition.
units.label: Point 24 Part 1 Art. 42

units.text: 2. Unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law, the procurement notice must contain the following electronic documents:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 42

units.text: 1) a description of the procurement subject matter in accordance with Article 33 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 42

units.text: 2) justification of the initial (maximum) contract price. A contracting authority operating in a foreign State shall also state the currency used to determine and justify the initial (maximum) contract price and to pay for goods delivered, works performed or services provided, and the procedure for applying the official exchange rate of that foreign currency against the Russian rouble, set by the Central Bank of the Russian Federation and used in making those payments;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 42

units.text: 3) requirements for the content and composition of procurement applications in accordance with this Federal Law and instructions for completing them. Requirements that restrict the number of procurement participants may not be imposed;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 42

units.text: 4) the procedure for examining and evaluating tender applications in accordance with this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 42

units.text: 5) the draft contract;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 42

units.text: 6) a list of additional requirements for the procurement notice, procurement participants and the content of procurement applications when procuring:
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 42

units.text: а) specialized depositary services and fiduciary management of pension savings, as established under Article 19 of Federal Law No. 111-FZ of 24 July 2002 “On Investing Funds to Finance Funded Pensions in the Russian Federation”;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 6 Part 2 Art. 42

units.text: б) specialized depositary services provided to the authorized federal body and fiduciary management services, as established under Article 24 of Federal Law No. 117-FZ of 20 August 2004 “On the Savings and Mortgage System for Housing Provision for Military Personnel”;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 6 Part 2 Art. 42

units.text: в) works connected with regular carriage of passengers and baggage by road and urban surface electric transport, as established by the federal law governing the organization of regular carriage of passengers and baggage by road and urban surface electric transport.
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 6 Part 2 Art. 42

units.text: 3. The procurement notice shall be posted, in the case of:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 42

units.text: 1) an electronic tender, at least fifteen days before the deadline for submitting procurement applications;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 42

units.text: 2) an electronic auction, at least fifteen days before the deadline for submitting procurement applications, except where the initial (maximum) contract price does not exceed three hundred million roubles or the initial (maximum) contract price for construction, reconstruction, major repairs or demolition of a capital construction facility does not exceed two billion roubles, in which cases the notice shall be posted at least seven days before the deadline for submitting procurement applications;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 42

units.text: 3) an electronic request for quotations, at least four working days before the deadline for submitting procurement applications.
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 42
